evidence.rationale: 出勤 session、時間與重播規則由 Attendance 擁有；Repository 提供當下存取與打卡點。跨 owner 原子交易不代表合併模型，保留既有 context status。

concepts.definition: Actual attendance lifecycle, Repository-member clock eligibility, immutable point snapshots and attendance facts.

A User-submitted proposal to append a complete historical Attendance session or close that User's existing open session; it is not an Attendance fact until a current effective Repository ADMIN approves it.
Retained pre-cutover Workplace records only; no runtime writer, membership or management. Current clock points are Repository-owned coordinates and radius with an optional address description.

relationships.meaning: Account User administration reads the Attendance-owned open-session activity projection for administrative display; it does not authorize User suspension or transfer Attendance writer or lifecycle authority to Account.

capabilities.intent: Record valid attendance while preserving eligibility, replay, version, and isolation semantics.

implementation.scope: Clock-in validates Repository coordinates, radius, current GPS accuracy and effective member access; clock-out uses the original immutable point snapshot even after member removal.
implementation.note: Attendance implementation evidence is static; remote/device acceptance is separate.

capabilities.intent: Let an active User propose a missing complete session or a missing end time without directly changing authoritative Attendance facts.

implementation.scope: The submitting User can propose a closed session for a currently eligible Repository point, or propose only an end time for their own open Repository session; each proposal snapshot is durable and remains pending until reviewed.
implementation.note: A proposal never mutates an existing started time or a closed session.

capabilities.intent: Let a current effective Repository ADMIN User approve or reject a pending Attendance supplement, with approval atomically appending the Attendance fact and decision event.

implementation.scope: User-owned Repository owner access and Organization-owned Repository effective ADMIN access are checked on every read and decision; current OrganizationOwner grants implicit ADMIN for its Organization-owned Repositories without a persisted Repository grant, and requesters cannot approve their own requests. Review responses disclose only replayed. Exact actor-bound replay remains available after ADMIN or all Repository access is revoked, but still requires active qualification and matching identity; malformed durable receipts cannot establish success. Submission receipts remain unchanged.
implementation.note: Approval adds or closes an Attendance session and records the reviewer in the same transaction; it does not grant Ledger rewards or calculate payroll.
